Subject: MAP & evaluation timeline for Aster Analytics – marketplace private offer path

Hi Maya — thanks for the conversation this morning. Per our sync, I wanted to capture a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on evaluation gates and the procurement path for converting to a private offer on AWS Marketplace (Aster is evaluating Azure/GCP too, but AWS is the priority).

High-level MAP (proposed):
- Week 1 (Feb 27–Mar 5): scoped POC – data connectors + 10k QPS inference sim; Redwood provides staging model + access.
- Week 2 (Mar 6–Mar 12): quality evals (customer prompt set); joint runbook and SLO targets.
- Week 3 (Mar 13–Mar 19): procurement paperwork — private offer paperwork with AWS, internal legal review, PO template exchange.
- Week 4 (Mar 20–Mar 26): production onboarding & Marketplace private-offer activation (billing path set, professional services if needed).

Open items:
1) Billing path preference (AWS consolidated billing vs direct invoicing).
2) Term length and commitment (12 vs 24 months).
3) PO approval SLA from your procurement team (target: 7 business days after signing).

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-page MAP workbook (ASTER_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our Private Offer checklist (Redwood_Private_Offer_Checklist.pdf). I’ll loop in Marissa for billing/contracting details and Karthik for marketplace operations.

Next step: Maya — can you confirm acceptance of the MAP and share your procurement contact? If we get PO intent this week we can target an AWS private-offer submission the week of Mar 13.

Thanks,

Hi Maya — quick answers from billing/ops perspective: 

- Monthly invoicing via AWS Marketplace: supported, but it requires a Marketplace private-offer with billing set to "Invoice to Company" and your W-9/Entity docs on file. There is a 30–45 day settlement window from AWS (standard). If Aster needs shorter settlement we can discuss a passthrough invoicing arrangement on Redwood invoices (adds an administrative fee).
- 90-day renewal notice: we can accept that term; will reflect it in the PO/contract language.
- PO template: attaching our standard PO template (PO_template_Aster.docx). Please populate billing address and remit-to details.

Engineering: we can schedule a 3-day pre-PO sample run in our staging fleet. Karthik — can you confirm capacity for a 3-day burst starting Mar 1 and produce the tail-latency / token-cost estimate?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the private-offer submission checklist with Karthik once we have PO intent.

Marissa Cole

Hi all — scheduling note and checklist from marketplace ops: 

- Capacity: confirmed for a 3-day staging run starting 2028-03-01. We will reserve a small dedicated slot to reproduce your expected prompt distribution.
- Deliverables for the pre-PO run (by EOD 2028-03-04): 
  * Tail latency report (p50/p95/p99) for the prompt set
  * Per-prompt token cost estimate and projected monthly spend at your target QPS
  * A short README with test harness details so your engineers can reproduce locally

Marketplace private-offer steps (what we’ll own):
1) Gather entity docs (W-9 / VAT ID).
2) Build the private-offer SKU and price sheet in AWS Marketplace test account.
3) Share the private-offer link for your legal to attach to the PO.
4) Once PO is submitted, initiate the AWS acceptance flow (usually 3–7 business days).

Notes/risks: If you choose consolidated billing under a parent account with existing marketplace billing, we need the parent account ID to map billing. If legal redlines exceed our standard terms (e.g., 90-day notice is fine), approval cycle could add 7–10 days.

I’ll track all marketplace artifacts in the HubSpot deal and share the test private-offer link when ready.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Marketplace Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
